The video opens with two men standing in an indoor archery range, presumably for a tutorial or demonstration. The man on the left, wearing a gray T-shirt with the text "DUTCHTARGET EST. 2004" in orange lettering, stands next to a compound bow on a stand. The video then cuts to the man in the gray shirt, who explains how to put on the knocking point and where to place it. He puts on a bow square and looks at the lines and marks on it, which are in millimeters, to show where the starting point is. The setting includes flags of different countries in the background, giving a sense of an international archery environment. The video transitions between the two men and close-ups of the archery equipment being used.

Initially, he holds up two small pieces of yellow thread. He uses a gold-colored bow square labeled "Belber" to measure and position the thread on the bowstring, using it to create small knots. As he proceeds, he occasionally moves away from the camera and speaks, then returns to further refine the knotting process. He eventually removes the bow square. Then, he grabs an arrow to test the nock, ensuring it is secure and properly positioned against the newly-tied nocking point. The background includes flags from different countries and other archery-related equipment, suggesting an indoor archery range or workshop. There are close-up shots of the hands tying the knots.

The video segment features a young man wearing a gray "DUTCHTARGET EST. 2004" (DUTCHTARGET established 2004) t-shirt. He is in an indoor archery range. Initially, he is preparing his bow, which is mounted on a stand. He takes out a blue lighter and uses it to burn off the loose ends of a yellow knot on the bowstring. He mentions that this is important to avoid damaging the string's serving. The camera then cuts to the man standing in front of a wall with several flags, then drawing and shooting arrows at a target set at 30 meters. The arrows land in the blue and yellow rings of the target. Finally, he stands in front of the target, indicating the arrow placement.

The video features a young man in a gray "Dutch Targetz" t-shirt, discussing archery techniques indoors. He begins by standing next to a large target board with arrows already in it, pointing out the grouping and position of his bare shafts, explaining that they are lower than his group and why he needs to adjust the knocking point. The scene transitions to a closer shot of him holding a knife, demonstrating how to make straight cuts into the knocking point without damaging the serving. He uses the flat side of the knife against the serving for precision. Subsequently, the video shows the man in action, attaching a quick knocking point to a bow propped up in a rest, then taking aim and shooting at a target in the distance, releasing several arrows. Finally, the camera returns to the target board, where the arrows are now grouped more tightly near the bullseye, showcasing the effectiveness of the adjustments.
